scope: Static x64 instruction and command-table evidence for the identified owner-supplied 431.60 binaries, with separately attributed root-agent live selector and request-versus-effective-status observations. This static investigation does not independently qualify SET acceptance, restoration or physical power.

method.binary_access: Expanded DLL and SYS read as files; neither inspected image was loaded by this static investigation.
method.addresses: All recorded instruction and command-table addresses are RVAs relative to the recorded PE image base, not live process or kernel addresses. Command-table function VAs have the SYS image base subtracted.
method.verification: Re-read both exact binaries, verify SHA256, re-decode every published instruction range, and verify command/size/flags/handler table entries.
method.publication: Binary identities, small relevant instruction ranges, and dispatcher-table entries only. No driver binary, installer, raw GPU payload, kernel memory dump, scanner result, private undo file or machine-local path is included.

public_nvapi_wrapper.evidence: RVA 0x1966B5 compares the caller to 0xF8; RVA 0x196702 writes byte 0xF8. Client GET and SET conversion routines call this helper. This describes the public wrapper conversion, not every raw RM caller the kernel can accept.

raw_rm_read_only_observation.adapter_scope: Owner's Gigabyte RTX 2080 SUPER AORUS Xtreme / TU104 with 16 GB memory modification.

raw_rm_read_only_observation.implication: The public wrapper's F8 conversion does not require replacing or seeding the existing raw FE request. Preserve the validated live caller; do not infer raw RM rejection of FE from the wrapper's F8 check.

limitations: Static identities apply only to these exact files, not a driver-version allowlist or GPU-family constants.
Live transport capture, PCI/handle pairing, stable role-to-native binding, units, opaque-field preservation, exact write projection and full restoration remain independent requirements.
No power request, caller creation/removal, registry edit, BAR0 scan, driver installation or GPU-state change was performed by this static investigation.
The known 3548/3480-byte transport uses a different native ABI and must remain separate from 2524/2456.
The original NVAPI-only comparison found no 261C literal; the additional kernel evidence establishes that getter without treating an absent user-mode literal as proof of absence.
No physical power or current enforcement measurement is provided here.

request_acceptance_vs_effective_cap.scope: Additional offline disassembly of the same identified SYS. No GPU access, writes, request creation/removal or physical power measurement was performed by this static investigation.

separately_reported_live_observation.source: Root agent live 431.60 comparison in the same session; linked live report owns write/restoration qualification.
separately_reported_live_observation.adapter_scope: Owner's Gigabyte RTX 2080 SUPER AORUS Xtreme / TU104 with 16 GB memory modification.
separately_reported_live_observation.interpretation: Both above-maximum requests settle at a 360.938 W native status plateau after an initial 350 W sample. This is consistent with a 350 W request clamp plus status uplift, not a strict 350 W effective status at every sample.
separately_reported_live_observation.qualification: These are separately reported request and native status values, not a physical power measurement by this static investigation.

static_findings.finding: Client SET dispatches through PMGR method +0x1918; initialization at 0x5892d4 installs target 0x5888ec.
Client row SET admits caller bytes F5 through FE, inclusive, broader than the public NVAPI wrapper F8 conversion.
Client row SET forwards request u32 +4 and caller byte +8 to bound native policy method +0x210 with fixed request type 3; no decoded override flag is supplied.
Decoded native policy constructor installs base setter RVA 0x533990 at method +0x210.
Base setter resolves request-type vote group and updates the caller vote via 0x533a50.
Types 0, 1, 2, and 3 select separate vote groups. Type 3 selects native object +0x190.

Native CONTROL SET compares requested value with aggregated type-0 minimum and type-2 maximum, then forwards FE with request type 3. This native route is not an understood bypass of the effective cap.
Native STATUS serializer copies effective output +4 from separate incoming status word +8. Exact request readback alone does not establish effective status.

request_acceptance_vs_effective_cap.conclusion: No understood reversible override route was identified by this bounded static review. The downstream clamp implementation was not completely traced; caller changes or bound changes are not qualified. Record the separately reported settled 360.938 W native status plateau for both 351 W and 400 W requests as a material remaining limitation of the tested 431.60 configuration, not a physically qualified override.
